author: IviFetita
body:
Avicus love!

What is Avicus Love and How play it
It is easy! You write in your face or hand, or, if you prefer, a little drawing of avicus saying "Avicus Love". You can upload 1, 2 or 3 images!
Tip: You can edit the photo of a drawing writing Avicus Love... :D
After it, you can take a photo of it!
and upload it to imgur or gyazo... Good Luck! 
Here's mine (In my hand :D)


Bye!
